about_the_game:
Valoris is a game that blends Souls-style 3D action with roguelike strategy elements, challenging players' tactical thinking and combat skills. Precise timing, strategic decisions, and random elements keep each battle fresh and exciting.

Game Modes: Hero Build Mode: Players choose from a variety of strategies to complete levels and build their own hero builds. Ranked Challenge Mode: Players challenge other players' hero builds with their own hero builds, competing for higher rankings and rewards.

Cross-Platform Connectivity: Unlike other roguelikes, Valoris supports cross-platform play, allowing PC players to challenge opponents on mobile devices.

Global Connectivity: Unlike other games that require players to select a server first, Valoris boasts a globally connected server system.

High-Quality Action Roguelike Experience: Valoris sets a new benchmark for roguelike graphics quality and stability. With the rapid advancement of mobile technology, Valoris's project quality continues to improve, rivaling traditional roguelikes.
